Container.Name: Fond
Container.Overview: Fond is a fast, uncluttered recipe keeper. Save recipes from any website (including straight from your phone's share sheet), cook with tick-off ingredients, step timers and a screen that stays awake, weigh ingredients instead of scooping them, convert units and scale with baker's percentages, keep a history of every change, and gather recipes into beautifully typeset cookbooks you can print or share with a link. One small container, a single SQLite file, no external database. Imports directly from Mealie.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the Fond web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Recipes database, photos, and the import folder for Mealie backups.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: Optional. The address people use to reach Fond through your reverse proxy, for example https://recipes.example.com. Used for share links and link previews.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data folder (Unraid: 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the data folder (Unraid: 100).

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated IPs or CIDR ranges of your reverse proxy. Defaults to all private ranges, which suits a proxy on your LAN or Docker network.

Config.Name: Send HSTS header
Config.Description: Set to true once Fond is only reached over HTTPS.

Config.Name: AI API address
Config.Description: Optional. An OpenAI-compatible API (for example http://[IP]:11434/v1 for Ollama) used as a fallback for pages without recipe markup. Can also be set in Fond's settings.

Config.Name: AI model
Config.Description: Optional. Model name for the AI API, for example gemma3:12b.
